claim: SCellBOW infers the survival probability and predicted risk score for the user-defined tumor subtypes and SCellBOW clusters by fitting a random survival forest (RSF) machine learning model with SCellBOW embeddings.
source: SCellBOW infers the survival probability and predicted risk score for the user-defined tumor subtypes and SCellBOW clusters. The survival risk of the different groups is predicted by fitting a random survival forest (RSF; Ishwaran et al., 2008) machine learning model with SCellBOW embeddings.
evidence: This is a description of the survival prediction methodology in SCellBOW, with a citation to Ishwaran et al., 2008.

claim: CITE-seq using Hashtag Oligos (HTO) was performed to pool samples into a single 10 X Genomics channel for scRNA-seq.
source: For the in-house dataset, we performed CITE-seq using Hashtag Oligos (HTO) to pool samples into a single 10 X Genomics channel for scRNA-seq (Abidi et al., 2020).
evidence: This is a description of the experimental method used for library preparation, with a citation to Abidi et al., 2020.

claim: A total of 6296 cells were recovered with CellRanger.
source: We recovered a total of 6296 cells with CellRanger, and their gene expression matrices were loaded on R.
evidence: This is a data point from the sequencing results.

claim: After quality control, 4819 cells and 33,538 genes were left for further analysis.
source: We subsequently eliminated doublet HTOs (maximum HTO count  > 1) and negative HTOs. Singlets were used for further analysis, leaving 4819 cells and 33,538 genes.
evidence: This is a data point from the quality control process.

claim: Automatic cell annotation was performed using the Seurat-based Azimuth using human PBMC as the reference atlas.
source: We performed automatic cell annotation using the Seurat-based Azimuth using human PBMC as the reference atlas (Hao et al., 2021; Appendix 2—note 2).
evidence: This is a description of the cell annotation method used, with a citation to Hao et al., 2021.

claim: Six major cell populations were defined: B cells, CD4 T cells, CD8 T cells, natural killer (NK) cells, monocytes, and dendritic cells.
source: We defined six major cell populations: B cells, CD4 T cells, CD8 T cells, natural killer (NK) cells, monocytes, and dendritic cells.
evidence: This is a description of the cell type annotations derived from the analysis.
